$comment: Artifactory repository inventory for CSWT. Exported from the Artifactory REST API (GET /api/repositories, filtered to the cswt project) and annotated by hand. Owner: Platform Engineering; the remote allow lists are owned by GIS (GIS-STD-022). Regenerate with scripts/export-repositories.sh, then re-apply the notes. Last export 2024-11-04.

repositories.notes: The only npm registry permitted by DEPENDENCY_POLICY.md. Every component .npmrc points here. Resolution order is local first so an @meridian scoped package never falls through to the public mirror (GIS-2601 was a dependency-confusion finding before the scope was reserved).
@meridian/* packages: canopy-ui, iris-widget, domain-fixtures. Published only by the Jenkins library's publish stage, never from a laptop (that used to work; TOOL-1122 removed the permission).

Public npm mirror. Xray blocks download of anything failing cswt-block-critical-high, which is why some upgrades 'do not exist' when you npm install them: the package is there, the download was blocked. Check the Xray tab in Artifactory before raising a ticket. Retention 365 days since TOOL-1288; before that the cache was purged at 90 days and rebuilding old Angular 12 workspaces broke because the versions had gone.

mirrorOf * in settings.xml. Adding an upstream is a GIS-STD-022 change with a 10 day SLA; jcenter was removed in 2021 when it shut down and the Gradle projects (there were two) were converted to Maven rather than find a replacement.
Release artifacts for the Spring Boot services and the shared libraries (meridian-platform-parent, meridian-audit-starter).
Red Hat GA. Needed for the ubi based Boot images and the MQ RA.
Added for the Beacon Kafka spike in 2023. Nothing in prod uses it; left in place pending the Beacon decision.

Pull-through for the agents and the cluster. The Dockerfiles in ../docker reference the underlying repos by name rather than the virtual because the Xray block on docker-remote is stricter and we want the build to fail there, not at deploy.
Built images. Tag is the Jenkins build tag; 'latest' is refused by a user plugin (TOOL-1041).
UBI base images. GIS-STD-021 appendix B lists the approved paths.
Docker Hub, allow listed. library/nginx is deliberately not on the list (ADR-0007). Node images are build-stage only.
statements-api and exposure-calc. No publish pipeline yet (TOOL-1444).
Packaged charts from ../helm, pushed by the library's Helm package stage. The deploy stage pulls the chart from here, not from the workspace, so the deployed chart is the scanned one.
CAB evidence bundles from Jenkinsfile.release (scan reports, test results, approvals). Seven year retention per records policy. Read by audit; do not clean.

local.$comment: Demo estate equivalents. Verdaccio on the port from PORTS.md stands in for npm-virtual; there is no local Maven or Docker proxy.
